onboarding.title: Set up Beresta
onboarding.mode_local_description: Your notes stay encrypted on this device. You can connect a sync server later without losing anything.
onboarding.mode_server_description: Not available in this build yet. Continue locally for now — connecting a server later will not affect your local notes.
onboarding.passphrase_hint: This passphrase protects your notes. Beresta cannot recover it if you forget it.
onboarding.switch_to_unlock: I already have an account at this location
unlock.title: Welcome back
unlock.description: Enter your passphrase to unlock your notes.
unlock.wipe_start_link: Can't unlock, or need to erase this device's copy?
unlock.wipe_warning: This permanently deletes every local file for this account on this device: notes, attachments, and revision history. It cannot be undone. Backups stored elsewhere are not affected.
shell.title: Your notes
shell.detail_placeholder: Select a note, or create one, to start editing.
attachments.dropzone_hint: Drag files here, or paste an image, to attach them.
revisions.restore_confirm: Replace the current content with this revision?
data.title: Backups & Data
backups.title: Backups
backups.empty: No backups of this kind yet.
backups.restore_whole_confirm: This replaces your entire current notebook with this backup's content. A safety backup is taken first, but this cannot be undone from within the app.
export.title: Export
export.warning: Notes and attachments are exported as plain, unencrypted files. Anyone with access to the destination folder can read them.
import.title: Import
import.warnings_title: Some content could not be fully imported:
quicknote.title: Quick Note
shellintegration.title: Quick capture & startup
shellintegration.autostart_conflict: A different Beresta install is registered to launch at sign-in; enabling this will replace it.
sync.title: Synchronization
sync.status_disabled_description: This account is local-only. Changes stay safely on this computer.
sync.status_offline_description: The configured server is unavailable. Local editing remains available.
sync.status_current_description: There are no known pending synchronization changes.
sync.status_failed_description: Synchronization stopped and requires your attention. Local editing remains available.
sync.server_unavailable: Server connection settings arrive in the synchronization phase. Your local collection will not need migration.
sync.journal_empty: No synchronization conflicts or quarantined operations.
sync.devices_unavailable: Other devices and revocation controls appear after a server is connected.
sync.server_fingerprint_warning: Compare this fingerprint with the value shown by your server administrator before connecting.
sync.error_unauthorized: This device is not authorized. Request a new invite or verify that it has not been revoked.
sync.error_rate_limited: The server is receiving too many requests. Synchronization will retry automatically.
sync.error_quota_exceeded: The server storage quota is full. Remove unused attachments or ask the administrator to increase it.
errors.account_exists: An account already exists at this location. Try unlocking it instead.
errors.no_local_account: No local account exists at this location.
errors.not_found: This note is no longer available. It may have been deleted.
errors.wrong_workspace: That item does not belong to this workspace.
errors.unknown_workspace: This account has no known workspace.
errors.unlock_failed: The passphrase is incorrect, or this account's data is unreadable.
errors.keystore_unavailable: Windows key protection is unavailable on this device.
errors.key_invalidated: The platform key protecting this account was invalidated; the account must be re-created.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
